children: U.S. spot Ethereum exchange-traded funds returned to net inflows after one day.
SoSoValue data for Oct. 23 showed U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net inflows of $4.35 million. The funds posted net outflows of $110.5 million a day earlier.

By product, Fidelity's FETH led with $3.58 million in net inflows. Morgan Stanley's MSSE also recorded net inflows of $773,440. BlackRock's ETHA and ETHB, as well as Grayscale's ETH and ETHE, posted zero net inflows.

title: U.S. Spot Ethereum ETFs Turn to Net Inflows, Add $4.35 Million
